svg.title: L3 Dash - pin ladder
svg.text: One block per housing, one row per cavity. Every wire runs straight from its cavity to where it lands. Read left to right.
L3-BLW-1 · 12 AWG RED · RT14 · capped at the far end
Dust-capped receptacle at the HVAC case — the replacement motor plugs in with the luxury package
L3-BLW-2 · 12 AWG BLK · RT14 · capped at the far end
Return to the dash ground, 12 AWG (G15) — the low-side final stage (≥ 20 kHz, its own freewheel
diode) plugs in here as an adapter between receptacle and motor (D-257)
L3-MOD-1 · 16 AWG RED · capped at the far end
Dust-capped receptacle behind the dash — live when F13 gets a fuse (D-274)
L3-MOD-2 · 16 AWG BLK · capped at the far end
L3-SD · DTP06-4S · Under the driver's seat
L3-SD-1 · 12 AWG RED · RT27 · capped at the far end
L3-SD-2 · 14 AWG RED · RT27 · capped at the far end
L3-SD-3 · 14 AWG RED · RT27 · capped at the far end
Driver seat common return - motor, heater and
L3-SD-4 · 12 AWG BLK · RT27 · capped at the far end
L3-SP · DTP06-4S · Under the passenger seat
L3-SP-1 · 12 AWG RED · RT28 · capped at the far end
L3-SP-2 · 14 AWG RED · RT28 · capped at the far end

L3-SP-4 · 12 AWG BLK · RT28 · capped at the far end
L3-SPF-L-1 · 16 AWG speaker · RT30 · capped at the far …
The speaker's lead through the mating DT06-2S, capped until luxury picks it (A17). Twisted with its
pair; never shares a chassis ground - the amplifier's outputs are bridged

L3-COL · hard-wired at the box, no plug there · PMU box
Ignition switch: ACC → 33 kΩ · IG → 15 kΩ · ST → 6.8 kΩ, all summed onto this wire. D-610: its resistors
and diodes are potted into a short sealed pigtail at the switch - part of the switch, not of the
Light switch E-01: PARK → 33 kΩ · HEAD → 15 kΩ · DIMMER-HI → 8.2 kΩ (fed from the HEAD side) ·
PASS → 3.3 kΩ. D-610: its resistors and diodes are potted into a short sealed pigtail at the switch -
part of the switch, not of the harness
Stalk F-02: LEFT 1.8 kΩ · RIGHT 10 kΩ · OFF 47 kΩ, contacts to column ground. D-610: its resistors and
diodes are potted into a short sealed pigtail at the switch - part of the switch, not of the harness
Stalk D-03: HIGH 4.7 kΩ · LOW 10 kΩ · INT 18 kΩ · OFF 47 kΩ · WASH 470 Ω + 1N4148 (band toward the
contact; R12 / Y2, ladder_a2.cir - the 1.8 kΩ + 1N5819 of D-381 leaked hot and lifted OFF past the fault
line). D-610: its resistors and diodes are potted into a short sealed pigtail at the switch - part of the
Pedal switch F-11 through 4.7 kΩ; other terminal → dash ground. D-610: the series resistor sits on
the PMU box's board at this wire's end, not in the harness
Spare P084 adjustable plunger switch on the brake pedal, fed from the F3 switch supply branched
off L3-COL 10 in the leg through F24 (D-278, D-412)
Horn pad through 8.2 kΩ · wink L NO through 18 kΩ · wink R NO through 33 kΩ — three resistors
joined onto this wire; the two wink resistors sit on the plate board and reach it on J2 pin 3 through
DP-CUR 7 (D-499, D-504, D-521). D-610: the horn pad's 8.2 kΩ sits on the PMU box's board; the winks'
Ignition switch B terminal · light switch E-01 common through F24 in the PMU box after F3, on its
Light switch common and the brake-wake
Light switch E-01 common and the brake plunger (DV19, DV25)
Wiper stalk D-03 WASH contact (same terminal as the WASH ladder leg); contact's other side →
Parking brake switch → brake warning lamp
Parking brake switch C-04 terminal BR (switch body grounds through the lever bracket)
Kick-down switch B-32 at the throttle pedal, one terminal. Ignition-fed off O12 through its own
inline fuse - never off F3, whose 5 A also carries the ignition switch, the light switch and the wake
L3-DASH · hard-wired at the box, no plug there · PMU box
Dash illumination lamps E-06, E-07, E-10 (RL) + head unit illumination wire - O20 is the illumination
bus only, on with PARK / HEAD, plain on/off; the lamps are dimmed through their return on
Glove box lamp H-01 +; lamp − → lid switch H-02 → dash ground
L3-HU · hard-wired at the box, no plug there · PMU box
Head unit red (ACC) wire; USB-C module +

Solid wire: live. Dashed: run and capped at the far end. A box on a wire is a resistor potted into the switch's pigtail (D-610); #12 / #16 / #20 is a circular's contact size. Generated by rx7.py diagrams - do not edit.
